name: star4tilt
description: Four-pointed star slab stretched 1.25x along x, tilted 35° about x then 20° about z, and offset by (0.4, 0.3, -0.5) so its symmetry, extrusion axis and center are all unaligned with the turntable. Visibility uses the interior-only rule.
projection: u = x*cos(theta) + z*sin(theta); v = y; the viewer looks from the direction (-sin(theta), cos(theta)) in the x-z plane.
